question: Which forms and transcendent qualities of Kalika are affirmed in worship?
premises: Kalika is addressed as having crow-form and being beyond time.
The speaker declares worship of Dakshina Kalika.
inference: Worship is directed to Kalika as both form-taking and transcending time.
plain_english: I worship Kalika, the southern one, who has the form of a crow and is beyond time.
